reuse.why: Follows the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard pattern with one new sibling guard, reusing db.first and the account types.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once and only invoked from each link function, as the existing guard is.

placement.why: The new guard sits next to ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts and runs at the top of each provider's link function before any write, where the tree already validates links.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and a focused test.

maintainability.why: One definition of the rule is easy to own; each new provider must still remember to call both guards, since there is no single pre-link entry point.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link functions call the new guard alongside the existing one.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking in accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, fintegra, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking).
